status_definitions.ready_for_external_review: The item is in place and the reviewer can verify it directly.
status_definitions.pending_internal: The item is expected to be produced by internal work (B-track or Agent A track) before the next review cycle.
status_definitions.pending_pilot: The item is expected to be produced by the controlled pilot (B7, B9, B18) before the next review cycle.
status_definitions.pending_external_review: The item is expected to be produced by the external review itself (a third-party document addressing the readiness matrix).
status_definitions.pending_governance_change: The item is gated on a dedicated governance change (e.g. relaxing the no-go list, promoting an area to approved_for_generic_scope).
status_definitions.not_applicable: The item does not apply to the current scope.
status_definitions.cancelled_with_rationale: The item was identified but is not required (with rationale).

claude_review_status.rationale: Claude review is a separate workstream. The Phase 51N checkpoint (Agent A side) prepared a Claude review pack; Claude review itself is performed outside this branch. The B-track governance pack does not represent Claude review as completed. This tracker's Claude review status moves to 'completed' only when the user provides an actual Claude review result. Until then, the status is 'in_progress_external'.
claude_review_status.rule: Do not mark Claude review as completed by virtue of having prepared this closeout tracker, the B10 data room, or any other B-track artifact. Do not represent Claude review as part of the B-track governance pack.

global_notes: This tracker is the closeout state of the B-track governance pack with respect to external review readiness. It is not external validation.

External review closeout does not mean external validation has occurred. A 'ready_for_external_review' status means a third-party reviewer can verify the item directly; it does not authorize any external claim.

Claude review is separate. The B-track governance pack does not represent Claude review as completed. The Claude review status in this tracker is 'in_progress_external' until an actual Claude review result is provided by the user.
All 'pending_*' items are correctly categorized. Each entry names the expected evidence and the workstream that produces it.

The no-go claims remain active. None of the 'pending_*' items authorize any external claim. None of the 'ready_for_external_review' items authorize any external claim. The reviewer is bound by the no-go list and is forbidden from producing any external-claim language.
